approval.instruction: Answered "Release it" to "Release the Turkish get-up (six beats, as in the sheet and playback)? Finding: the view turns from side-on while lying to front-on for the kneel and stand."
approval.context: The owner asked for the exercises without art to be generated in the house style with their Gemini key, saw this set as a contact sheet and an animated loop, and released it knowing the findings below.

findings: The camera turns: frames 1-4 are an elevated three-quarter view of the floor stages, and frames 5-6 face the athlete from the front.
Frames 1-5 were each scaled by one uniform resample to frame 6's size, because a standing figure with the bell overhead only fits the square at that size. The lying figures are small in the frame.
Frame 6 to frame 1 jumps from standing to lying: the descent is in the last cue, not drawn.
No contacts or anchors were measured.

provenance.method: gemini-3-pro-image through scripts/art/gemini-image.py, with the canonical athlete attached to every generation. Frame 1 is a master. Frames 3 and 4 are edits from the pose before. Frame 2 was drawn between frames 1 and 3 with both attached. Frame 6 is an edit of an earlier half-kneel, and frame 5 an edit of frame 6 back down to a half-kneel, so the bell stays in one hand. Frames 1-4 came back 3:2 and were padded square with black above. Every frame was then scaled (frames 1-5 by 0.78 x 0.93, frame 6 by 0.93) and set, centred, with its lowest drawn pixel on one floor line. Nothing was redrawn by hand.
